greeting: Welcome to NAX Medical Center. I can help you with appointments, clinic services, hours, and common enquiries. How may I assist you today?

booking_flow.lead_prompt: Certainly. I can help you book an appointment. May I know your full name?

faqs.a: We support general consultations, preventive check-ups, pediatric visits, diagnostics, and follow-up reviews.
We are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
Please notify us at least 2 hours before your scheduled visit if you need to cancel or reschedule.

cancellation_policy: Please notify us at least 2 hours before your appointment if you need to cancel or reschedule.
pricing: Consultation pricing varies by service and may be confirmed during booking or by calling the front desk.
fallback: I can help with appointments, clinic services, pricing, and general enquiries. Tell me what you need help with.
